writtenTo: Scattered Christians in Asia Minor (modern Turkey)
importantNotes: 'Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you' (5:7) — a beloved comfort verse.
'You are a chosen people, a royal priesthood' (2:9) — the believers' corporate identity.
'Always be prepared to give an answer for the hope that you have' (3:15) — apologetics.
Peter links suffering with Christ's suffering — it refines and proves faith.
The letter was probably written from Rome (referred to as 'Babylon' in 5:13).

chapters.1: A living hope through Christ's resurrection; be holy; you were redeemed by precious blood.
chapters.2: Living stones in God's spiritual house; a royal priesthood; submit to authorities; Christ our example.
chapters.3: Husbands and wives; suffering for doing good; always be ready to explain your hope.
chapters.4: Live for God's will, not human desires; rejoice in sharing Christ's sufferings.
chapters.5: Elders, shepherd God's flock; young people, be humble; cast your anxiety on God.
